Hi Claire / Tom,

As we approach your renewal, I wanted to propose a format that makes the QBR and roadmap demo easier to attend across teams. Rather than one long block, can we split the session into short, focused "microblocks" (20–30 minutes each) aligned to stakeholder lanes:

- Platform & Ops: performance, SLAs, visibility (20 min)
- Engineering: integration patterns, runtime improvements (30 min)
- Product & Roadmap: upcoming features and rollout plan (25 min)
- Commercial & ROI: usage trends, pricing levers, renewal ask (20 min)

Benefits: attendees join only the lanes relevant to them, recordings + prework cover the rest, and we can surface targeted next steps per lane. Attached a one-pager (QBR-demo-microblocks-agenda.pdf) and a short prework spreadsheet to collect attendee priorities (Storix_QBR_Prework.xlsx).

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jun 06: 09:30–12:00 (microblocks run back-to-back)
- Wed Jun 07: 13:00–15:30 (afternoon option)
- Thu Jun 08: 08:00–11:30 (early option)

If none of these work, share the ranges that fit your execs and we’ll slice accordingly. Quick ask: could you confirm the stakeholder list (ops, infra, product, procurement) so we can map lanes?

Thanks — looking forward to making this high-signal for your teams.

—
